UserBitacora.title: User Bitacora State
UserBitacora.description: User notebook state containing tasks, notes, contexts, streak log, and focus

day.description: Current active day string in YYYY-MM-DD format

focus.description: Task ID of the current focused task

stamp.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD when all daily tasks were finished

log.description: Record of completed task counts by date

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of last modification in milliseconds

/users/{userId}.description: Private state document for an individual user notebook
